# Kiron

> Kiron is a workout app for iPhone, iPad and Android that runs real training programs and lets any day of them change. Start from one of 36 ready-made programs, have Kiron build one from a few answers, build your own, or bring a plan from ChatGPT, Claude or a coach as text or photos. Then shorten or lengthen a day, train with another gym's equipment, add core or a finisher, or swap a lift, while the rest of the program carries on. Lifting, runs, rides, swims and rows share one plan, one log and one muscle recovery picture.

## Ways to start a program

- **36 ready-made programs**, 2 to 6 days a week: strength (wave loading with training maxes, two beginner barbell plans, upper/lower, bodyweight, kettlebell, a first pull-up), muscle-building splits (push/pull/legs, upper/lower, a five-day split, full body, glutes), dumbbell, band and joint-friendly plans, and endurance plans (a first 5K, 10K, half marathon, marathon, cycling, sprint triathlon, rucking, walking, a fitness race). Filter by goal, days a week, equipment and level.
- **Built for you**: answer a few questions and Kiron writes a program.
- **Built by hand**: write your own from scratch.
- **Brought in**: paste a plan from ChatGPT, Claude, a coach or anywhere, or choose up to four photos or screenshots of it. Kiron reads exercises, sets, reps, rest and phases, matches each exercise to its library, and shows the program to check and edit before it starts.
- Two programs can run at once, for example a strength program and a 10K plan.

## Changing a day without changing the plan

- Make today's workout shorter or longer: shorter cuts extras and accessory sets first and keeps the main lifts; longer adds sets for the muscles the week is behind on. Runs and rides can be shortened or lengthened too.
- Train at another gym (saved gyms such as a hotel or a friend's garage): exercises swap for the equipment there.
- Add core, arms, shoulders, glutes, calves, a cardio finisher or stretching to today.
- Swap an exercise just for today, for a while, or from now on.
- Every change says what it did and can be undone. A missed workout can be started now, moved to another day or skipped; several missed ones can push the plan back.
- Start any workout from any program, a saved workout, or an empty one built as you go.

## Logging

Set-by-set logging with last time's weight and reps, warm-up sets, supersets, notes on each exercise, reps in reserve after the last set (more to spare moves the next weight up faster), a plate calculator showing the plates for each side of the bar, and a rest timer that starts when a set is ticked. Pounds or kilograms, miles or kilometers. Light and dark mode.

## Recovery and progress

- A muscle recovery map built from every set and every cardio session. With permission, it also counts workouts other apps save to Apple Health or Health Connect (runs, rides, ski days), and offers an easier session when today's muscles are still tired. Those are read on the phone and never stored.
- A chart for every lift (estimated one-rep max, best ever, heaviest set), new records marked as they happen, weekly, monthly and yearly reports, weekly set targets per muscle, 27 badges and a streak of weeks in a row.
- Body weight, body fat and lean mass from Apple Health or Health Connect (waist too, on iPhone), read on the phone and never stored.

## Works with

- Apple Health and Google Health Connect: finished workouts are saved there when sync is on.
- Workout history import from Fitbod, Strong and Hevy (their export files). History only: those exports carry no program.
- Share a workout or a gym's equipment list as a link (trykiron.com/w/… and /g/…), which opens in Kiron. A shared copy holds no personal details and expires after 180 days.

## AI and privacy

Kiron uses AI only when someone asks it to read a plan or build one: that text or those photos go to Anthropic's Claude, after the person agrees, and the consent can be withdrawn in Settings. Ready-made programs, logging, recovery and everything else work without AI. Health data is read on the device and isn't stored or sent.

## Pricing

Free to download. A subscription unlocks programs and logging:
- **Weekly**: $4.99 a week, with a 3-day free trial.
- **Annual**: $49.99 a year (about $0.96 a week).
Prices are in US dollars; the App Store or Google Play shows local prices.

## Availability

- iPhone and iPad: Apple App Store
- Android: Google Play

Kiron is made by Berkeley Labs LLC. Support: help@trykiron.com
